# Velvet Docs

This is the machine-readable entry point for the Velvet Plugin Platform documentation.

The default locale is English. The Chinese mirror uses the `/zh-Hans/` route prefix.

## Current status

- The repository contains an Alpha UI Kit contract and local qualification fixtures.
- The external Plugin SDK, Marketplace ABI, and production WASM/sidecar runtime remain release gates.
- Host React wrappers are first-party surfaces. Third-party UI uses the framework-neutral UI Bridge.
